'''Shirkel''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Iol]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that was controlled by the company [[Tangan Industries]].

==History==
Skirkel was the youngest city on Iol and was constructed in [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]]. It had a smaller population than the other cities on Iol and the majority of Shirkel's residents were [[Mining/Legends|miners]] that worked at nearby sites. Tangan Industries appointed the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Anoon'olan]] as Shirkel's [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]], but most of the city's residents pledged their allegiance to [[Kai Lunn]], the leader of the [[Miners' Union]].<ref name="TUR" />
